report_summary: The report grounds coordination in explicit grocery, health andUEFArelay messages and clearly leaves prompted teamwork versus spontaneous emergence unresolved. It handles cumulative page volume and sibling-wiki cleanup uncertainty well, but its claim that moderator response began around the peak misses earlier deletions and its isolated-XSS narrative underuses earlier concrete probes.
